notes.title: Aksun – Demo Update 0.9.4g
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/821d453adbd3f7854e0d51219bf3edc60941779c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Demo Update & Playtest Closure[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The [b]Aksun Playtest[/b] branch will officially close on [b]September 3[/b].[/p][p]However, you will still be able to keep playing the same build through the [b]Aksun Demo[/b] branch (already updated). Only your [i]tutorial progress data[/i] from the Playtest will be carried over to the Demo build.[/p][p][b]Why this change?[/b][/p][list][*][p]We originally planned to update the Demo in mid-September with our roadmap announcement.[/p][/*][*][p]But because so many of you requested a build to keep playing, we’ve decided to make the Demo available earlier than expected.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]How future builds will work[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each Demo build will first be tested through a [b]closed Playtest[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Then, 4–8 weeks later, it will be made public as the next Demo update.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If you’d like to experience new builds early or help us by joining future Playtests, [/p][p][b]Please sign up here: [url="https://forms.gle/63YwZhTbw55Hoo226"]Apply for Future Playtests[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Next Steps[/b][/p][list][*][p]The official [b]Roadmap Announcement[/b] will be shared via Steam in [b]mid-September[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/7bdefe9b4405a43b46cf5da754ad5c9f027d2ae6.png"][/img][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/ZcAeRzdbUg"]https://discord.com/invite/ZcAeRzdbUg[/url][/p][p]Thank you for your incredible support, and see you in the next run![/p][p]— The Aksun Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.9.2h
notes.content:
[h2]🛠️ Hotfix 0.9.2h[/h2]
[b]This hotfix addresses several critical bugs identified in version 0.9.2g.[/b]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed mismatch between Tainted Sunjang’s attack range and visual indicator
[*]Removed player pushback mechanic from Jisil, Chapter 2 boss fight
[*]Updated internal version label for consistency
[*]Corrected language setting behavior
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note 0.9.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/b9d090f1df0c75df241bac25443430b44177a862.png[/img]

[h2]🛠️ Aksun Demo Patch 0.9.2[/h2]
[b]This update delivers pre-scheduled improvements and resolves key issues based on feedback from version 0.9.1.[/b]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Refined Artifact acquisition mechanics
[*]Replaced Artifact Chime cost system with single-choice selection
[*]Rebalanced and polished Artifact Chime Talents
[*]Implemented AutoAim functionality
[*]Enhanced VFX and indicator decals for clarity
[*]Added new features to the Settings menu
[*]Various minor UI and UX adjustments
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Resolved input freeze after obtaining Weapon Chime in the starting stage
[*]Fixed rare issue causing unexpected slowdown of game timescale
[*]Corrected malfunctioning Artifact Chime Talents
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/f72d3e840cd8f3f25972a1cbbc801b46eacaf261.png[/img]

[h2] 💌 Huge Thank you[/h2]

Thank you for playing the Demo ver.0.9.1. We have recieved a lot of feedbacks and heartwarming reviews from all around. This is helping us so much with the development, the things we should focus on and the things we over thought about. We appreciate it all and we are pushing ourselves to make a better game. Thank you!

[/list]

notes.title: Greetings to the Aksun Community
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/168aa1e6e2f8601740ad6d0b6fc594b828450d24.jpg[/img]
[h1]Greetings, Wanderers![/h1]

We are thrilled to finally reveal [b]Aksun[/b] to the world.

[i]Aksun[/i] is a [b]roguelike action game[/b] born from the echoes of forgotten faiths and twisted devotion. At its heart lies a cursed [b]Casket[/b]—[b]Aksun[/b]—sealed to contain the remnants of a fallen cult and its Evil Prophet.

You have been drawn into this [b]Casket[/b]—[b]Aksun[/b], into the Seal itself, where broken spirits, once worshippers and betrayers alike, clash endlessly. Each encounter is a test. Each fall draws you closer to an unsettling truth.

[h2]Core Experience[/h2]

Fast, visceral combat merging intense responsiveness with overwhelming enemy hordes
Deep strategic growth through shamanic weapons, spiritual artifacts, and fateful choices
A haunting narrative where failure becomes growth, and salvation walks hand in hand with ruin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/f72d3e840cd8f3f25972a1cbbc801b46eacaf261.png[/img]
[h2]Demo Launch[/h2]
[b]May, 2025[/b] Our first public demo will offer a glimpse into Aksun's depths — and the horrors that whisper from within.

[h2]Join Our Journey[/h2]
Our official [b]Discord community[/b] will open alongside the demo! Come share your feedback, theories, and your own stories carved through survival and despair.

Prepare yourself. Aksun does not shatter. It merely waits... for the next soul.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/ca67c4e29d80b15186b5d83a600c7266f97ca887.png[/img]

[h2]The Aksun Team[/h2]

[i]We started this project as a one-person development effort in [b]November 2023[/b], with a relentless passion to create a roguelite that combines [b]superior action, strategic depth, and a compelling world[/b].Today, [b]a team of 6 to 10 talented developers[/b] has gathered to bring Aksun to life.[/i]

[b]If you find our vision intriguing, please add Aksun to your Wishlist on Steam![/b] Your support makes a huge difference in our journey.

[i]Thank you for reading. We can't wait to share this journey with you.[/i]
